name: @finapp/m35-devportal
description: M35 — Public APIs & Developer Portal (Stage 6D-3, mvp:false): the governed developer portal + API-gateway FACADE over the platform — developer APPLICATIONS, API CREDENTIALS, published API PRODUCTS and app SUBSCRIPTIONS (public exposure). It is a GOVERNED FACADE: a product exposes only ALLOW-LISTED operations, each carrying the m02 permission it requires — public exposure NEVER bypasses m02 RBAC or m01 tenancy (that stays authoritative). It is NOT a secrets manager: an API credential persists ONLY a one-way secret_hash (sha256:) OR an opaque secretref: pointer (the m30 seam) — ZERO plaintext credential VALUE columns; real key management is deferred to m41 behind a fail-closed port. CREDENTIAL issuance/rotation/revocation are HUMAN-governed (AI/system/automation never issue); PRODUCT publication and SUBSCRIPTION approval are CONTROLLED actions (maker-checker/SoD, AI never approves, default deny); a published product is IMMUTABLE (trigger). It CONSUMES m34 (marketplace) + m33 (integration) BY CONTRACT: a product surfaces a marketplace listing/connector by OPAQUE reference validated through a fail-closed CatalogSourcePort — m35 owns NO connector/marketplace engine and reads no m33/m34 table. QUOTAS/USAGE are m39-saas's: consumed behind a fail-closed UsageQuotaPort (m39 unbuilt -> deny public exposure) — NO second quota/metering engine. It uses the devportal_* table prefix (integration_* is m23's, connector_* is m33's, marketplace_* is m34's) and owns devportal.lifecycle ONLY. Declares /api/v1/developer, the devportal.* permission namespace (GAP-4 resolved), the devportal.lifecycle event family (published through the ONE m06 outbox) and the DEVPORTAL_ audit prefix. No secret value; no external network/provider; no arbitrary code.
